subject: re-doc
title: (R)RE.DOC.------C.CONT.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 295 (CMOA(II)-53). RE-DOC (redocumentation) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; C-CONT (composite continuance) is the partner. From the subject: TRS (transition) and INFO-F (information focus). From TRS: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) and SPT-DYM (spiritual dynamics). From INFO-F: AF-NT (affinity nature) and AFTF (affinity transfer). From SOC-RT-DY: PART (participation). From SPT-DYM: ALT-F (alternative functionalism). From AFTF: CRTF-PROG (cross-transfer progressionalism).
